author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a stroke-drawn plane climbing up-right (fuselage, a near wing sweeping down, a far wing and a tail fin rising back) above a perspective runway; reads as takeoff/departure. The rejected drawing was a boxy outline plane above a flat line. An outlined fuselage (attempts/v1-outlined-fuselage.svg) read as a check mark.
omissions: The reference's dashed runway centreline is dropped: dashes need a 16-tall runway, and the plane needs that height. The plane is drawn in strokes rather than as the reference's outline.
